summary: Inside the hovercraft, which is shaking violently from the impact of sentinels attacking the ship, Morpheus unlocks the EMP detonator. Trinity watches him as he asserts that Neo will make it in time.

what_changes.after: Committed to trusting Neo's survival to trigger the EMP
what_changes.evidence: Morpheus opens the lock on the EMP detonator.

event_hint.one_line: Morpheus prepares to fire the EMP to save the ship from sentinels.
